search_order: repository-local Lean outside the owned target
official or theorem-specific public Lean 4 projects
historical formal systems and human sources as non-Lean completion evidence
repositories_and_registries: this repository at the recorded base revision
all local packages recorded by Formalizations/Lean/lake-manifest.json
Sourcegraph public indexed Lean repositories, including archived repositories and forks
GitHub public code search if unauthenticated access permits it
google-deepmind/formal-conjectures recursive Git tree at a resolved immutable commit
api_forms: rg over repository-local and pinned Lean source
git rev-parse and git status over already materialized pinned packages
Sourcegraph search stream V3 with lang:Lean and count:100
GitHub REST repository and code search with per_page bounds
GitHub REST commit and recursive-tree APIs for selected immutable statement collections
lake env lean over a target-owned #check/#print-axioms probe

immutable_ref_rules.mathlib: existing lake-manifest commit and package tree; clean worktree required
immutable_ref_rules.external: branch discoveries receive no candidate credit until resolved to a 40-hex commit and inspected at that commit
immutable_ref_rules.search_responses: dated and SHA-256-bound discovery evidence only; not immutable source or proof evidence

credentials_policy: Use unauthenticated public endpoints only. Record HTTP denial or rate limiting as an access failure, never as a negative result.
expected_negative_evidence: Record every query, completion or truncation state, result count, response SHA-256 when retained, and access limitation. Bounded zero results never imply global absence.
classification_policy: Normalize every discovered declaration against the exact frozen target. An interface or statement-only anchor is M3; a mismatch or uncheckable/incompatible candidate is M5; M1 requires immutable independently reproducible kernel evidence; M0 requires a repo-local checked wrapper and accepted trust closure.
credit_boundary: This protocol governs candidate discovery only. It cannot supply proof, H0, M0, audit-completion, or theorem-completion credit.
